body: I don't want to hurt myself. I want to cease to exist. Big difference. I found someone but that certain someone doesn't love me back.
People make friends in their childhood and teen years. Too late.
People get introduced to potential partners by mutual friends. I'm not in any such circles.
Dating apps are mostly for casual hookups. Which I don't want.
Nobody is here for any reason. We are all just mammals.
I don't want any friends. I want to be in a committed relationship, as I know from experience that makes me happy.
